cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Not That Subject
cards.instruction: Choose one subject you cannot let the scene reach. Redirect whenever the conversation gets close.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've booked your car into the garage with the cafe. Remember my lesson about making a useful morning of an errand? Let's have breakfast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why does my car need a garage?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you're asking practical questions. Next one: does the breakfast include unlimited toast? I taught you to check that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The mechanic wants to talk to me about the dent before we eat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're finally learning to delegate. Give me the keys and you secure us a table; I'll handle his questions while you practise ordering for two.

reason: Replace the weak bus diversion with a clear division of tasks that lets A intercept the damage conversation, presented as a lesson in delegation.
